paper.title: Hierarchical Floorplan-Guided Vision-Language Exploration for Embodied Question Answering
paper.central_claim: HFLEX-EQA improves active EQA by combining online hierarchical scene graphs, a frozen VLM selecting specialized exploration modes, semantic frontier/viewpoint planners and weak topological floorplan priors; benchmark comparisons and quadruped deployment support the combined design.

provenance.notes: anchors_version=v2 (3ececdd11cc3d144). Session/receipt unavailable; taxonomy hash binds domain, main and sub cards named explicitly. No external lookup or code execution.

evidence.quote: GraphEQA [ 4 ] further demonstrated the benefits of grounding VLM planning with an online hierarchical scene graph augmented with semantic room labels, frontiers, and task-relevant visual memory.
evidence.support_explanation: Nearest explicit ancestor; claims not fresh invention of scene-graph memory.

evidence.quote: In our experiments, we construct \mathcal{G}^{\mathcal{F}} from HM3D [ 23 ] semantic annotations in simulation and manually from known room layouts in the real world.
evidence.support_explanation: Global unseen-room prior is exogenous, privileged relative to purely online RGB-D baselines, not inferred from observations.

evidence.quote: Metric geometry and agent localization are not retained.
evidence.support_explanation: Privilege does not include exact geometry/localization; avoid overstating.

evidence.quote: For each room, at most M key views are selected
evidence.support_explanation: Question-ranked bounded per-room retrieval, not fixed total context.

evidence.quote: We constrain the VLM to only predict classes present in the floorplan
evidence.support_explanation: Missing floorplan class can bias observed-room classification; perturbation robustness not topology robustness.

evidence.quote: If an answer a_{t} is provided with confidence \kappa_{t}\geq\kappa_{\mathrm{min}} , it is returned as the final answer and the episode terminates.
evidence.support_explanation: VLM self-confidence stop, not externally validated EQA answer gate.

evidence.quote: If the current room cannot be matched to the floorplan or no path to c^{\star} exists, w(c) are set to zero
evidence.support_explanation: Defined fallback for unusable prior; arbitrary plausible wrong topology not explicitly tested.

evidence.quote: Other factors affecting view quality, such as viewing angle or illumination, are not explicitly modeled.
evidence.support_explanation: Viewpoint maximizes geometry visibility not actual answer identifiability.

evidence.quote: This gives 108 OpenEQA episodes and 114 ExploreEQA episodes.
evidence.support_explanation: Filtered single-floor semantic-annotation subsets, not full benchmark.

evidence.quote: For multiple-choice runs, success means selecting the correct answer. For no-choice runs, answers are graded by an LLM.
evidence.support_explanation: Choice ground truth defined; free-form grader identity/rubric/agreement not provided.
Same Gemini floorplan toggle versus75/63.2 supports conditional extra-prior benefit.
Naive prompt-floorplan competitor compared; extra prior alone not full explanation.

evidence.quote: All methods use a budget of 50 iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: Matched high-level iteration cap, not equal model calls/tokens/physical budget.
Separate explicit ground-truth semantic branch; do not attribute main online object labels to GT.

evidence.quote: The no-choice results were obtained by replaying the recorded observations, scene graph and planner history while removing the answer choices.
evidence.support_explanation: Real free-form answers are offline replay, not independent autonomous trials.

evidence.quote: while keeping the scene graph and planner history unchanged.
evidence.support_explanation: Image perturbation study freezes downstream state/history, so not full closed-loop robustness.
Confidence threshold fixed; calibration/false answer endpoint missing.

evidence.quote: All perception, mapping, and hierarchical planning are executed onboard in real time, except for the VLMs, which are queried via their APIs.
evidence.support_explanation: Jetson Thor mapping and remote VLM; no measured per-stage runtime or USD.

signatures.information: Frozen GPT-4o/GPT-5.5/Gemini3.5/Opus4.8/Qwen3.5-9B; question/options, online RGB-D Hydra graph, question-ranked keyframes, decisions and exogenous semantic topology; no metric floorplan localization.
signatures.operation: VLM outputs mode+room/object/class and optional answer/confidence; room mode ranks object-semantic frontiers, object mode computes occlusion/coverage viewpoint, find mode mixes graph-distance room progress, semantic entrance scores and frontier size; navigate and rebuild graph.
signatures.output: Low-level path and renewed visual evidence or final answer
signatures.conditions: Metric posed RGB-D, online perception/room mapping, valid semantic room classes in prior; reliable navigation.
signatures.feedback: Fresh observations and graph; self-reported answer confidence≥0.8 stops, no independent answer verifier.
signatures.selection_rule: Static mode selection and frontier argmax each planning turn; no retained harness optimization.
signatures.selection_data: Current question, online graph and supplied whole-scene floorplan; no development/tuning partition reported.
signatures.persistence: Within-episode graph/map, CLIP keyviews and action history only.
signatures.later_use: Following planner calls retrieve at most3 views per room and current/object view.
signatures.claimed_effect: Gather needed information with more appropriate exploration than one strategy.
signatures.failure_boundary: Wrong prior labels constrain room classifier; geometric best viewpoint can miss useful lighting/angle; no GT-free prior estimation tested.

signatures.information: 108/114 annotation-bearing single-floor episodes; five fixed VLMs, 50-step cap; real manually supplied floorplan and GPT5.5.
signatures.operation: Compare GraphEQA/ExploreEQA, remove FP/VP/SF, add FP to GraphEQA, evaluate GT semantic branch; replay real traces without choices and with perturbed images.
signatures.output: Answer SR, planning steps, path length; real answer/mode consistency examples.
signatures.conditions: Multiple-choice exact correctness; free-form LLM grading unspecified; replay state held fixed.
signatures.feedback: Post-run answer correctness, not retained policy edits.
signatures.persistence: Recorded real histories used only replay evaluation.
signatures.claimed_effect: Reported answer gains across VLMs; real feasibility and replay consistency.
signatures.failure_boundary: Sim prior from semantic annotations, limited subset; perturbation replay not closed loop; no repeat/variance/cost.

gap.author_gap: Prior EQA uses locally observed graph/memory and largely one exploration strategy, neglecting available unseen-room structural context.
gap.checked_gap: GraphEQA lineage supports relevant residual but exact single-strategy claim against originals unverified; extra global room prior changes information budget.

claims.text: Hierarchical prior-guided method outperforms EQA baselines across backbones.
claims.setting: 108 OpenEQA and114 ExploreEQA filtered HM3D single-floor episodes; choice and no-choice; five VLMs.
claims.baseline_control: GraphEQA/ExploreEQA same frontier backbone and50-iteration cap; not equal prior information or full API compute.
claims.selection_vs_test: Previously unseen scenes stated; development overlap not disclosed.
claims.result_denominator: Gemini choice75.0/63.2 versusGraph46.3/54.4, Explore54.6/53.5; exact choice and LLM-graded no-choice.
counterevidence: Extra semantic floorplan prior changes information budget; no no-choice grader audit.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported gains for filtered benchmark with supplied topology, not equal-sensor-information superiority or full benchmark SOTA.

claims.text: Floorplan, viewpoint and semantic frontiers contribute to gain.
claims.baseline_control: One removed at a time; GraphEQA+FP; GT-semantic variants separately.
claims.selection_vs_test: Weights chosen statically; tuning split unspecified.
counterevidence: Longer paths than some variants; no prior corruption or hierarchy-only toggle.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Components help under fixed supplied prior configuration; robustness to erroneous/missing topology not demonstrated.

claims.text: Real-world deployment and robustness support practical EQA.
claims.setting: Quadruped, D455/LiDAR/IMU/JetsonThor, GPT5.5 APIs; manually known room layout.
claims.baseline_control: Selected question examples; no robot alternative comparison; no-choice/images perturb via replay.
claims.selection_vs_test: Previously unseen environments asserted, no construction-independent route/task preregistration.
claims.result_denominator: Seven tabled question runs, all displayed correct; replay47/50 modes agree; no repeat count or uncertainty.
counterevidence: Free-form replay and fixed-graph perturbation not fresh closed-loop trials.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Qualitative real feasibility plus offline planner consistency, not denominator-complete transfer reliability.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported active simulated EQA answer rates improve with the combined hierarchy and supplied floorplan, with component toggles; real executions illustrate feasibility but free-form and perturbation studies are fixed-trace replay, not counted independent closed-loop transfer.
unresolved: Success grader/rubric for no-choice answers unspecified.

G.reason: Concrete residual after GraphEQA: different information deficits need distinct exploration and unobserved room context. Fixed predecessor originals unavailable, no broad novelty proof.

M.reason: Three typed modes map missing known-room/object/unseen-room evidence to appropriate geometry/semantic operations; topological progress weights and fallback reconstructible. Weak-prior accuracy hypothesis lacks controlled corruption study; class restriction risks excluding actual room.

X.reason: Online RGB-D graph, question-ranked views, JSON modes, formulas7-14, threshold and parameters specified. No exact prompts/answer-grader specification and depth robustness leave implementation/verifier boundaries.

measurement.reason: Defined answer criteria and108/114 sim denominators; no-choice judge audit absent, seven selected real question examples appear single trials, no repeated task counts/aggregate SR. v2 single-real-trial ceiling2.

causality.reason: Fixed five backbones, component leave-one-outs with Gemini, GraphEQA+FP and semantic-GT checks isolate some mechanism contributions. Floorplan input unlike baseline privileged, no all-factor budget/call matching or isolated hierarchy toggle.

holdout.reason: Previously unseen indoor scenes and real platform, but development overlap/contamination unspecified; semantic-region-derived prior and single-floor filtering restrict scope. Replay perturbs image not online graph.

statistics.reason: Episode counts provided; no stochastic rerun counts/CI, no endpoint failure decomposition, selected real answers single executions (v2 ≤1).

cost.reason: Planning steps and meters are useful proxies, 50-iteration budget disclosed; missing API calls/token/cost/latency including failures. Real-time prose not measurement.

reason: Complete fixed text supports scoped static EQA harness review; unreported prompts/variance not author-deleted material.
